title: Local databases: SQLite, Room, SwiftData and Realm

videos.script:
Sessions grow with use, so they need a database. {{four}} On a phone that is almost always SQLite. Room on Android and SwiftData on iOS are ways of talking to it. React Native reaches the same file through a library. Realm is the one with an engine of its own.

So this lesson learns SQLite once. {{tables}} You create the planner's two tables and ask the database for the week, instead of adding it up yourself.

Then you make the planner three years old. {{big}} Twenty thousand sessions. You ask SQLite how it will answer the week's question, and it says it will read every row to return eight. {{index}} One index later, it reads the eight.

And last, a batch with one bad row in it. {{batch}} Without a transaction, half the batch stays. With one, none of it does, and the download can simply start again.
